headline: Yelp CFO David Schwarzbach Sells $150,000 in Company Shares
summary: Yelp chief financial officer David Schwarzbach sold company shares worth $150,000, according to an SEC disclosure.
why: Yelp operates a widely used online platform connecting consumers with local businesses through reviews and digital advertising.

impacts.name: Yelp
impacts.why: CFO insider sales represent standard equity monetization rather than changes in digital advertising revenue.
